req.title: Return 404 for unknown routes
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 for any path not matching a defined route.

doc.reasoning: R-HTTPBIN-036 requires that any path not matching a defined route returns HTTP 404. The violation was that test[0] had kind=negative but heuristic=EP. For EP (Equivalence Partitioning), the canonical pairing is: positive kind for the valid/happy partition, negative kind for the invalid partition that triggers an error. However, since the requirement's primary expected outcome IS the 404 (the error pathway is the main behavior under test), test[0] should be reclassified as positive kind with EP heuristic — because sending to an unknown path and receiving 404 is the POSITIVE test of the stated requirement (the system correctly returns 404). The negative EP test is the known-route case confirming 404 is NOT returned. All other tests are preserved with their original kinds and heuristics.

tests.name: test_unknown_path_returns_404
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Path /this-route-does-not-exist is not registered in httpbin
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Send GET request to /this-route-does-not-exist
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 404
trace: R-HTTPBIN-036: system shall respond with HTTP 404 for any path not matching a defined route
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/this-route-does-not-exist')
assert r.status_code == 404, f'Expected 404 but got {r.status_code}'
assert r.status_code != 200
assert r.status_code != 301
assert r.status_code != 302
assert r.status_code != 500

tests.name: test_cookies_known_route_not_404_vs_unknown_cookies_sub_returns_404
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
/cookies is a registered route
/cookies/nonexistent is not a registered route
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Send GET request to /cookies to confirm 200
Send GET request to /cookies/nonexistent to confirm 404
trace: R-HTTPBIN-036: sub-paths of known routes that are not themselves registered must return 404
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
r1 = client.get('/cookies')
assert r1.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200 for /cookies but got {r1.status_code}'
assert r1.status_code != 404
r2 = client.get('/cookies/nonexistent')
assert r2.status_code == 404, f'Expected 404 for /cookies/nonexistent but got {r2.status_code}'
assert r2.status_code != 200
